p: eleventh year: Of Zedekiah's reign, or of Jeconiah's captivity.
like in thy greatness: Meaning that he was not the same in strength to the king of the Assyrians whom the Babylonians overcame.
little rivers to all the trees: Many other nations were under their dominion.
of God could not hide him: Signifying that there was no greater power in the world than his was.
mighty one of the nations: That is, of Nebuchadnezzar, who was the monarch and only ruler of the world.
broken by all the rivers of: By this is signified the destruction of the power of the Assyrians by the Babylonians.
covered the deep for him: The deep waters that caused him to mount so high (meaning his great abundance and pomp) will now lament as though they were covered with sackcloth.

be comforted in the lower parts: To cause this destruction of the king of Assyria to seem more horrible, he sets forth other kings and princes who are dead, as though they rejoiced at the fall of such a tyrant.
art thou thus like in glory: Meaning that Pharaoh's power was nothing so great as his was.
uncircumcised with them that are slain: Read Eze 28:10.
